sn46.15:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rajagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrel Sanctuary.
sn46.15:1.2: Now on that occasion the Venerable Mahamoggallana was dwelling on Mount Vulture Peak—sick, afflicted, gravely ill.
sn46.15:1.3: Then, in the evening, the Blessed One emerged from seclusion and approached the Venerable Mahamoggallana …
sn46.15:3.3: with the change of names being the only difference …
sn46.15:4.3: In such a way the Venerable Mahamoggallana was cured of his illness.
